name: Tinker: Rocket Bombardment fires on the Sentry Turret's next attack after the Sticky Bomb, not only inside the mark's 500 ms window
contract: Rocket Bombardment's tooltip (spell 706695) promises: 'Casting Sticky Bomb now causes your Sentry Turret to fire a
rocket cluster on its next attack'. The cluster 706696 is therefore owed once per Sticky Bomb 500232 cast, on the
Sentry Turret's next attack, whenever that attack happens - not only when the turret's shot lands inside some short
The reported defect: with the turret already deployed and firing, a Sticky Bomb often produced no cluster at all.
The mark 706698 the cast plants on the turret carries DurationIndex 327, which SpellDuration.dbc resolves to 500 ms,
while the turret's Sentry Shot 706689 takes about two seconds between impacts, so a mark planted right after one
impact is gone long before the next one lands and the cluster never fires.
This scenario syncs the cast to just after a Sentry Shot impact, so the turret's next attack is a full cycle away, and
requires the cluster anyway. The turret must already be firing before the cast (a player melee request gives it a
focus target), which is the ordinary state in which the report was filed. It also requires that the cluster fires
once: the mark is consumed by the attack that reads it, so later attacks do not repeat it.
Not covered here: the cluster's client visual and the per-rocket travel are rendering.
